MADISON (WKOW) — The candidates for Madison mayor made their case to the public Monday night. The two candidates — incumbent Mayor Paul Soglin and challenger Satya Rhodes-Conway — met at a forum at the Madison Central Library. Among the issues they tackled, both reinforced their commitment to bringing to Madison a faster bus system called bus rapid transit. The election is Tuesday, April 2.
